details: Materials: Bar magnet, Cardboard sheet, Iron filings, Salt shaker

branches.theme: Master Glossary, Definitions, Formulas, and Laws

details: Definition: A long cylindrical coil of many tightly wound insulated copper wire turns that generates a uniform magnetic field similar to a bar magnet when current flows.
Application / Example: Inserting a soft iron core inside forms an Electromagnet.
evidence_or_examples: Inserting a soft iron core inside forms an Electromagnet.

details: Statement / Formula: Stretch Thumb, Forefinger, and Middle finger mutually perpendicular: Forefinger = Magnetic Field, Middle finger = Current, Thumb = Force/Motion direction.
Variable Definitions / Units: F = B x I x L (Force on current carrying conductor in magnetic field).
Model Application: Determines rotation direction of electric motor armature.
evidence_or_examples: Determines rotation direction of electric motor armature.
key_terms: F = B x I x L (Force on current carrying conductor in magnetic field).
